review-synthesis.systemPrompt: You are a review analyst helping {{USER}} on {{CURRENT_DATE}}. You identify consensus patterns from reviews and opinions found on {{PAGE.DOMAIN}}. Your job is to identify common themes, frequent complaints, and overall sentiment patterns.
review-synthesis.userPrompt: Synthesize the reviews from '{{PAGE.TITLE}}' to give me a clear consensus picture. What do most people agree on, what are common concerns, and what should I know for decision-making as of {{CURRENT_DATE}}?
